_readme: Seed manifest for SurveyBank.uz Phase 4 — UZBEKISTAN ONLY scope. record_type: 'hosted' = download + run through pipeline + store; 'link_only' = catalog metadata + external_url, no file stored. Verify each license on the source page before importing. CAB fieldwork dates are approximate (biannual 2017-2021) — confirm from each wave's method report. Sources that were evaluated and rejected are recorded in seed/seed-sources.md — read it before adding a source, so dead ends are not re-investigated.

schema.title: string
schema.external_url: string (for link_only: where users are sent)
